player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I never updated the `edges` in my graph responses; they remained empty lists despite the Game Master confirming connections. Additionally, I did not track visited rooms to detect loops or ensure all reachable areas were explored before stopping. Next time, I will strictly populate the `edges` dictionary with tuples like `("Previous Room", "Current Room")` for every move made. I will also maintain an internal mental list of visited rooms to avoid redundant paths and only send "DONE" when the set of visited rooms equals the set of all rooms I have encountered, ensuring no unvisited neighbors remain.
